subject: Private deployment upgrade plan: version pinning, maintenance window & rollback
messages:
From: Jessica Morris <jessica.morris@acme.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: samuel_choi <samuel_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - upcoming security patches and request for upgrade plan

Hi Lauren,

We've identified a CVE in the inference runtime base image that ACME security wants patched on our Redwood Private deployment (VPC). They asked for a formal upgrade/patch plan that covers: version pinning, proposed maintenance window(s), rollback approach, DB snapshot cadence, and any expected downtime. They also want confirmation about whether GPU driver updates are required and whether our KMS/HSM keys will be rekeyed.

Can your team send a concise plan we can include in our NOC bulletin and SOC audit notes?

Thanks,
Jessica
IT Security, ACME Corp

Attachment: security_scan_summary_20260302.pdf (scan stub)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Morris <jessica.morris@acme.com>
Cc: samuel_choi <samuel_choi@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - upcoming security patches and request for upgrade plan

Hi Jessica —

Thanks for the heads-up. We're preparing the formal plan; below is an executive summary we can include in your NOC bulletin. Full runbook and rollback checklist will be attached by EOD Friday.

Executive summary (high level):
- Scope: Redwood Private control plane + inference runtime nodes + optional on-prem admin console. No customer data plane rekeying required.
- Version pinning: We'll pin the inference runtime to 2.7.3 (security build) across your dedicated pool. We'll also pin the model artifact SHA at deployment time to prevent accidental drift.
- Maintenance window: Proposed weekend window: Sat 2026-03-14 00:00 — 06:00 PT (can shift earlier if ACME requires). We expect rolling restarts; single-region impact only.
- Expected customer impact: Short transient latency increases for warmup (~5–15 min per node) during each node restart. No full-app outage expected with canary + traffic draining.
- Rollback: Helm chart rollback to previous image tag + restore KV cache and prefix cache snapshot. DB migrations: none in this patch; if needed, migrations will be behind feature toggles.

I'll loop in Markus for driver/infra specifics and Samuel for the detailed rollback checklist.

Best,
Lauren
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_private_patch_plan_v1.pdf (v1 executive plan)

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, samuel_choi <samuel_choi@redwood.com>, Jessica Morris <jessica.morris@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - upcoming security patches and request for upgrade plan

Quick technical notes from infra: 

- GPU drivers: current CVE is in the inference base image; we do NOT need an immediate GPU driver update for this patch. If we did, we'd schedule driver updates in a separate maintenance window because they require instance-level reboots.
- OS patches: we'll apply base-image OS patches inside the container image and roll images via a rolling deployment. No host OS changes planned.
- Kernel / optimized kernels: we will run the kernel selection matrix in canary to validate performance. Expect 1–2% variance in 95th pct latency during canary.
- Batching/Cache warmup: automated prefix cache prewarm script will run during the deployment; we recommend routing 5% traffic to canary nodes for 30 minutes to collect KV warm state.

Operational checklist (abbreviated):
1) Pre-checks: snapshot KV store, create backup of deployments, export metrics baseline (latency/cost/throughput).
2) Canary: deploy to 2 nodes in a separate subnet, run smoke tests (healthcheck endpoints + sample prompts), validate quantization artifacts.
3) Roll forward: rolling update across AZs with traffic draining and 10-minute pause per availability zone.
4) Post-checks: run full acceptance test set, confirm no regressions in quality (eval set pass), confirm cost delta within 5%.
5) Rollback: helm rollback, restart previous pods, restore KV snapshot if cache corruption found.

Attachment: rollback-checklist.txt

Markus

From: Samuel Choi <samuel_choi@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jessica Morris <jessica.morris@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - upcoming security patches and request for upgrade plan

Adding the deployment runbook steps and monitoring hooks so ACME's NOC knows what signals we will watch during the window.

Runbook highlights:
- Monitoring: token-level latency, 95/99 pct, error rate (5xx), model quality drift alert (per-prompt eval set), GPU util, OOM events.
- Health endpoints: /healthz (runtime), /kv/status (cache), /metrics for Prometheus scraping.
- Smoke tests: 10 synthetic prompts covering short/long contexts and streaming paths. Failure criteria: >2% generation error or >10% latency regression over baseline.
- Post-deploy validation: automated sanity job will run for 45 minutes; if any alert fires, we begin rollback sequence.

Communication plan:
- 48 hours before: official maintenance notice via ACME NOC (you to confirm exact window).
- 2 hours before: Redwood ops Slack ping + dedicated bridge.
- During: minute-by-minute status updates in the bridge; 15-minute summary to ACME NOC.
- After: 2-hour postmortem if any incidents occur.

Samuel
Runbooks & Reliability

From: Jessica Morris <jessica.morris@acme.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: samuel_choi <samuel_choi@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - upcoming security patches and request for upgrade plan

Thanks — this looks good. A couple of follow-ups before we finalize the bulletin: 

1) Can you add the explicit rollback SLA window? ACME requires a max 60-minute window to restore full traffic in the event of critical failure.
2) Where will audit logs for the upgrade be stored? We need proof of the exact image tags and timestamps for SOC evidence.
3) Confirm there's no KMS rekeying; if any secrets are rotated, we need lead time to update our sidecar configs.

If you can update the plan with the points above, we'll lock the window for Sat 2026-03-14 00:00—06:00 PT and send the maintenance notice to our teams.

-Jessica

On a separate note, ACME's procurement is asking for a brief statement on whether this patch will affect billing (e.g., extended hours for dedicated capacity). Please indicate if we should expect any meterable delta.

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Morris <jessica.morris@acme.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, samuel_choi <samuel_choi@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 18:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - upcoming security patches and request for upgrade plan

Jessica — thanks for the quick review, and good asks. Short answers:

1) Rollback SLA: we commit to a 60-minute recovery SLA to restore previous image tags and traffic routing. The rollback checklist includes explicit timing gates and the on-call escalation timeline.

2) Audit logs: all deployment artifacts (image tags, helm release metadata, timestamps) will be pushed to the ACME audit bucket in your S3 (we'll upload the manifest and sign it). Additionally, our control plane will produce a signed event log entry. Link will be included in the final bulletin.

3) KMS/Secrets: No automatic rekeying as part of this patch. If we rotate any secrets manually, we'll coordinate a 72-hour lead time and provide config diffs.

Billing: There should be no additional metered charges for the rolling deployment itself. If you request a prolonged maintenance window beyond the proposed 6 hours or request additional reserved capacity for faster parallel rollout, that would be billable and we will flag it to procurement.

Next steps: I'll update the PDF with the rollback SLA line, the audit link placeholder, and a short billing note and re-send. Can we confirm the window now? If yes, ACME NOC will publish the 48-hour notice.

Regards,
Lauren

Attachment: redwood_private_patch_plan_v1-updated.pdf (pending audit link)
